text:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: spike in token introspect latency from external auth provider (avg RTT 1.8s -> 7.2s) affecting login flows and console access. auto-escalation sent to #oncall.

sre-jess: seeing errors in auth-proxy logs: `introspect timeout` and 502s for session-verification. Affected routes: /api/v1/auth/introspect (frontend + console).

platform-omar: confirmed. traffic pileup on auth-proxy -> request queue growth on ingress. CPU at 60%, but connection wait time high. Probably upstream.

prod-liz: customer portal reports users stuck on login spinner. CS reporting ~20 tickets in last 15m. Ana is triaging. @cs-ana can you get sample user IDs and error messages?

cs-ana: grabbing IDs now, will paste a redacted sample. most see `unable to verify token` then redirect loop.

oncall-jen: I am taking this incident. declaring Sev-2 for now until we confirm broad impact. Starting mitigation runbook: 1) increase introspect timeout to 10s locally, 2) enable short-circuit cache for recent tokens, 3) reduce non-essential token-verifies (dev/debug routes).

sre-jess: patching auth-proxy config to add prefix cache + bump timeout. Applying config in canary now:```
# auth-proxy config snippet
introspect_timeout_ms: 10000
prefix_cache_ttl_s: 30
skip_noncritical_verifies: true
```

platform-omar: rolling to 3 hosts canary -> 20% traffic. watching metrics.

monitoring-bot: deploy started by oncall-jen at 1767054402.

sre-jess: canary looks promising: backend error rate down 40% on those hosts, overall login success rate up from 68% -> 82%. still not back to baseline.

security-sam: we should not bypass introspect for console admin sessions. confirm we only cache short lived tokens and not extend scopes.

oncall-jen: agreed. cache only for tokens that validate local signature AND short TTL. will not touch admin routes.

prod-liz: CS update drafted: "We're seeing degraded logins due to an upstream auth provider latency. We're applying a temporary cache and rollback-safe tweak; some customers may still see slow logins. We'll post updates at status.redwood.ai." Thoughts?

cs-ana: sending that now. adding estimated affected users: ~3-5% of active logins in NA region.

platform-omar: reached out to provider support (ticket 982103). They acknowledge elevated error rates in a subset of their edge POPs. They say mitigation in progress on their side.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-202603-87. Paging rotation notified.

sre-jess: recommendation: keep short TTL cache (30s) + higher timeout for 30 mins, then reevaluate. If provider doesn't stabilize, fallback plan is to route console auth to a verified backup tenant (requires config flip, estimated 15m and must coordinate with security).

security-sam: prepping approval flow for tenant failover. need sign-off from prod + legal. notifying now.

oncall-jen: handoff to night shift in 1h — @sre-jess you'll be primary, @platform-omar secondary. I'll leave a follow-up message in 30m with status.

sre-jess: log pointers for follow-up: `kubectl logs -lapp=auth-proxy -c proxy | grep introspect` and verify `auth-proxy.metrics.introspect_latency` in grafana dashboard "auth -> introspect".

prod-liz: Customers to update: public status page + targeted emails for larger customers in 30m. @cs-ana coordinate.

cs-ana: emailing top 10 affected accounts now. included workaround steps (clear browser, retry) and timeframe estimate.

monitoring-bot: next automated update scheduled in 10m.

oncall-jen: quick note — avoid rolling large changes to auth-proxy while provider unstable. keep mitigation minimal and reversible.

sre-jess: ack. will keep changes to TTL + timeout only. tracking in incident runbook.

security-sam: if we flip to backup tenant, need to rotate keys and invalidate sessions; that will log out users. prefer to keep current path if provider recovers.

platform-omar: provider reports partial recovery in EU POPs, NA still degraded. we're seeing slow improvements on canary hosts. will update in 10m.

oncall-jen: thanks all — leaving a short playbook in this thread for night. please escalate immediately if admin console access drops or error rate >10% for >15m. :white_check_mark:

sre-jess: attaching quick debug commands for handoff:
```
# check failing endpoints
curl -s -D- -o /dev/null -X POST https://auth-provider.example.com/introspect -d 'token=xxx' -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
# useful grafana panels
/dashboard/db/auth-introspect
```

monitoring-bot: auto-update: 1767055280 - overall login success 85% (was 68%), introspect 95th pctl latency 1.9s (was 7.2s).

oncall-jen: handing off — status: mitigations in place, provider engaged, partial recovery. oncall shift: @sre-jess primary. leaving channel open.

sre-jess: taking over. will post hourly updates unless situation changes.

cs-ana: continuing customer comms. closing this thread once stabilized. :eyes:
